_about: Curated review notes shown in the map's record dialogs and in the About panel. Keys are Specimen_id values; values are one note or a list of notes. The build script adds its own automatic checks (duplicate IDs, text coordinates, ambiguous age text, missing coordinates) to these. Edit this file, not the HTML.
